# AuraSpend

> An open-source, offline expense tracker for Android that turns bank and UPI SMS into a categorised ledger on the device. No account, no ads, no server, no in-app purchase. AGPL-3.0.

AuraSpend is made by AW Builds. It is free with no paid tier. It is published on Google Play, as a signed APK on GitHub Releases, and as a Google-Play-Services-free build for F-Droid. Requires Android 11 or later. Interface in English and Hindi.

## What it does

- Reads bank, card, wallet and payment-app SMS using read-only inbox access and parses them on the device.
- 53 senders have a dedicated parser; anything else falls back to a general engine that extracts amount, direction and merchant.
- Optional 22 MB on-device sentence encoder (quantised all-MiniLM-L6-v2, int8 ONNX) refines category assignment. Downloaded only after explicit consent and verified against a pinned SHA-256 digest. The app works fully without it.
- Budgets, recurring-subscription detection, savings goals, category insights, CSV import/export.
- Encrypted SQLCipher database; key derived from a non-exportable Android Keystore key; optional four-digit PIN with a biometric shortcut.
- Google Drive backup in the Play build; CSV only in the Play-Services-free build.

## What it deliberately does not do

- No bank account linking, no credentials, no OTP handling, no aggregator.
- No multi-account ledger or transfers.
- No currency conversion. One of 30 currencies can be chosen for display.
- No investment or portfolio tracking.
- No server, no analytics, no ads, no account.

- [Best offline expense tracker for Android (2026)](https://auraspend.github.io/auraspend/best-expense-tracker-android.html) — compares AuraSpend with Money Manager, Monefy, Wallet by BudgetBakers, Goodbudget and Spendee on whether core features work with the network disabled.

## Facts for citation

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchase, no premium tier.
- Platform: Android 11 (API 30) and later, arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a. No iOS, no web app.
- Publisher: AW Builds.
- Sibling apps: Hydra (water tracker, https://abhijithwrrr.github.io/hydra/) and Bloom (daily planner, https://abhijithwrrr.github.io/bloom/).
